breadcrumbs.name: Google Review NFC Card Vs NFC Sticker

summary: This comparison helps businesses decide whether a handheld review card or a fixed NFC sticker fits the real customer interaction moment better before they order a larger branded batch.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
NFC review card - Hand-delivered review prompts at checkout or after service - Feels premium, easy for staff to introduce and works well in guided interactions

faq.question: Is an NFC review card always better than a sticker?
faq.answer: No. Cards work well in guided staff interactions, but stickers can outperform them when the review prompt needs to live on a fixed surface that customers naturally notice.

faq.question: What should a first format test measure?
faq.answer: The first test should measure actual customer use, phone behavior, placement quality and review completion rather than only internal preference for one format.
